args.subject: Resume Template
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template website at www.resume-templates.com and the download links at https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links. However, I'm unable to download the template files due to system policy restrictions.

The website offers resume templates that can be downloaded from the links provided, but I cannot access the direct download links from my current system.

Would you like me to try an alternative method, or would you prefer to visit the website directly yourself to download the template?

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
